biotools.summary: HERGAST is a system for spatial structure identification and signal amplification in ultra-large-scale spatial transcriptomics data, employing a divide-and-conquer framework. It demonstrates improved performance compared to existing methods, identifying key biological patterns in colorectal tumors and breast cancer.
